test_assignment.methods: all twelve assigned frozen block-arm cells plus one common Degree reference

primary_metric.name: feasible_reward_over_common_clique_upper
primary_metric.numerator: exact Fraction of the stored binary contact weights in an independently checked feasible selected set; failure=0
primary_metric.denominator: independently verified deterministic zero-search weighted clique cover upper on the original graph; common to all methods in that context
primary_metric.aggregation: equal assigned-context mean within block/arm; equal mean of all four authoring blocks for the pilot arm summary; no complete-case exclusion
primary_metric.not: optimality ratio or ratio to a strongest feasible programme

contrast_units: same graph and authoring block paired before aggregation; all four blocks individually and descriptive four-block average

uncertainty.report: four block estimates, observed range, and sign counts; no programme/graph replication substituted for authoring replication

coverage_cost.completion: completed/requested assignments, including no-eligible bank failures
coverage_cost.runtime: equal-context means and medians of recorded CPU/wall seconds; no imputed missing runtime
coverage_cost.feature_work: completed-context work summarized separately; failures retain null work

proposal_curves.x: original authoritative slot prefix 1..12; no sorting or replacements
proposal_curves.eligible: static-valid nonduplicate AST and saved full-interface DAG gate passed; no new completed-context hard gate
proposal_curves.yield: cumulative eligible count; all failed/missing/duplicate slots remain in denominator
proposal_curves.utility: saved TRAIN J verified against all raw TRAIN contexts under frozen protocol; prefix best among eligible original slots only
proposal_curves.no_eligible: null best J, explicit no-eligible-bank counts per arm/prefix; never imputed as zero
proposal_curves.mean: yield averages all four blocks; best-J mean is null unless all four blocks have an eligible prefix; each block retained
proposal_curves.not: online learning, CPU anytime performance, or TEST prefix selection

outputs.figure: two TRAIN proposal-efficiency panels, 7in x 2.8in, Arial >=9pt; A purple, B blue, C slate, missing orange
outputs.table: three arms by four authoring-block TEST quality means, plus gate yield and completion; paired contrasts below; common Degree reference retained
outputs.json: input archive/member hashes, selected-AST hashes, independent reward/upper/mean reconciliation, paired counts, full slot statuses, authoring token metadata

authoring_metadata.scope: retain actual usage events per cell separately; no fabricated provider/model observations

scope: no new C3 or public/SOTA dominance claim
no candidate evaluation, replacement, test-based selection, or model invocation by analysis
archive_inventory: safe POSIX member inventory; reject traversal, absolute paths, links, duplicate members and ambiguous basename matches; never extract
frozen_source_bindings: verify protocol, authoring completion, TRAIN frozen selection, fresh input, evaluation receipt and all completed assignment counts before generating final results
